alloy.preparation: High-purity 99.999% polycrystalline Al foil (Alfa Aesar), same dimensions as metallic-glass ribbons; mounted on end in low-curing-temperature epoxy to expose 2 × 10^-4 cm². Wet polished with 1 µm diamond then 0.05 µm silica suspensions and rinsed with deionized water.
alloy.microstructure: Polycrystalline Al foil.

test_solution.preparation: Electrolyte also explicitly described as 3.5 wt% NaCl; prepared from ACS-certified reagents and 18.2 MΩ·cm resistivity deionized water. Both empty cell and electrolyte deaerated with nitrogen before experiment; duration and pH not supplied.

test_method.procedure_description: OCP measured for 1 h after adding electrolyte; anodic scan at 0.1 mV/s with reversal at 10 mA/cm²; potentials versus SCE. Numeric electrolyte temperature is not supplied. Median comparisons use the standard acquisition protocol; the low acquisition rate means Epit generally represents removal of a 0.5–1 µm-radius hemispherical volume.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Epit and Erp are the potentials where slope of the current-versus-potential curve changes suddenly; Epit concerns micrometer-scale stable pitting, distinguished from small preceding transients.

experiments.result_note: Approximate potential at the explicitly labeled Epit arrow in an individual example scan. This is not the median of Figures 5–8; overlap with the underlying summary population is unspecified.
